name: tyto
description: AI-first Chrome/Edge control: accessibility tree in, trusted CDP out, prompt session on disk.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/protocol && tsc --noEmit -p packages/fs && tsc --noEmit -p packages/secrets
scripts.check: npm run lint:imports && npm run secrets:scan && npm test && npm run typecheck
